revisionSchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_revisions (
id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, warehouse TEXT NOT NULL, warehouse_name TEXT NOT NULL, created INTEGER NOT NULL,
version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, closed INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
CHECK(status IN ('draft','posted','cancelled')), actor TEXT, employee TEXT);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS stock_revision_draft ON stock_revisions(warehouse) WHERE status='draft';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS stock_revision_warehouse ON stock_revisions(warehouse,created);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_revision_lines (
revision TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_revisions(id), lot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(lot)),
name TEXT NOT NULL, book REAL NOT NULL, actual REAL NOT NULL CHECK(actual>=0),
stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stale IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(revision,lot));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS stock_revision_lines_lot ON stock_revision_lines(lot);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS revision_receipt_insert AFTER INSERT ON stock_receipts WHEN NEW.status='posted' BEGIN
UPDATE stock_revision_lines SET stale=1 WHERE lot=json_array(NEW.warehouse_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.unit,NEW.content_unit,NEW.quantity_per_piece)
AND revision IN (SELECT id FROM stock_revisions WHERE status='draft'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS revision_receipt_delete AFTER DELETE ON stock_receipts WHEN OLD.status='posted' BEGIN
UPDATE stock_revision_lines SET stale=1 WHERE lot=json_array(OLD.warehouse_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.unit,OLD.content_unit,OLD.quantity_per_piece)
AND revision IN (SELECT id FROM stock_revisions WHERE status='draft'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS revision_receipt_update AFTER UPDATE ON stock_receipts
WHEN (OLD.status='posted' OR NEW.status='posted') AND (OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status OR OLD.quantity IS NOT NEW.quantity
OR OLD.warehouse_id IS NOT NEW.warehouse_id OR OLD.product_id IS NOT NEW.product_id OR OLD.unit IS NOT NEW.unit
OR OLD.content_unit IS NOT NEW.content_unit OR OLD.quantity_per_piece IS NOT NEW.quantity_per_piece) BEGIN
UPDATE stock_revision_lines SET stale=1 WHERE lot IN (
json_array(OLD.warehouse_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.unit,OLD.content_unit,OLD.quantity_per_piece),
json_array(NEW.warehouse_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.unit,NEW.content_unit,NEW.quantity_per_piece))
AND revision IN (SELECT id FROM stock_revisions WHERE status='draft'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS revision_sale_insert AFTER INSERT ON sale_lines BEGIN
UPDATE stock_revision_lines SET stale=1 WHERE lot=NEW.lot AND revision IN (SELECT id FROM stock_revisions WHERE status='draft'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS revision_movement_insert AFTER INSERT ON stock_movements BEGIN
UPDATE stock_revision_lines SET stale=1 WHERE (lot=NEW.lot OR (NEW.target IS NOT NULL AND lot=json_set(NEW.lot,'$[0]',NEW.target)))
AND revision IN (SELECT id FROM stock_revisions WHERE status='draft'); END;
revisionHeaders: SELECT id, status, created, closed, actor, version FROM stock_revisions WHERE warehouse=@warehouse ORDER BY created DESC, id DESC
revisionRows: WITH current AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM sale_stock WHERE warehouse=@warehouse AND @draft=1),
counted AS (SELECT * FROM stock_revision_lines WHERE revision=@id),
lots AS (SELECT id lot FROM current UNION SELECT lot FROM counted)
s.stock current,c.book,c.actual,CASE WHEN @draft=1 AND c.lot IS NOT NULL
AND (c.stale=1 OR s.stock IS NOT c.book) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END stale
FROM lots k LEFT JOIN current s ON s.id=k.lot LEFT JOIN counted c ON c.lot=k.lot
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=json_extract(k.lot,'$[1]') ORDER BY name,k.lot
revisionSave: FROM sale_stock s LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=s.productId
WHERE s.id=@lot AND s.warehouse=@warehouse AND s.stock=@book
revisionClear: DELETE FROM stock_revision_lines WHERE revision=@id AND lot=@lot
revisionTouch: UPDATE stock_revisions SET version=version+1 WHERE id=@id
revisionCounts: SELECT count(*) counted, coalesce(max(c.stale=1 OR s.stock IS NOT c.book),0) stale
FROM stock_revision_lines c LEFT JOIN sale_stock s ON s.id=c.lot WHERE c.revision=@id
revisionMovements: c.name,s.price/s.factor,@now FROM stock_revision_lines c JOIN sale_stock s ON s.id=c.lot
